targets.note: A Zoom meeting opens beside the calendar: Join Zoom with its mark, Or dial +1 669 444 9171 and 1 more, PIN and Passcode with Copy; Going? Yes lit; Edit, Prepare, Ask; the guests and their answers.
Your own event with several ways to join: Join Google Meet with its dial-in, the room under Other ways to join; the prep notes your Assistant wrote.
A past meeting: no Join, no Prepare. Its close-out (1 to approve, the summary, the tasks and where each stands, Open close-out) and its recording and transcript.
Double-click edits in place: title, day, start, length and guests, with Cancel and Save. The standup repeats every weekday, so Save asks This Event or All Events.
A phone meeting: Call +1 415 555 0132 (through Vyre's number when one is connected, else the phone), the PIN with Copy, and Add a video call.
A place: the address with Open in Maps and Copy, and Add a video call.
